question: What is the mean decolorization efficiency of the Box-Behnken center-point runs (pH 6.0, 70 mg/L, 0.70 g)?
rendered:
The mean decolorization efficiency of the Box-Behnken center-point runs is calculated as the average of the four runs with the same conditions: 

96.04%, 96.79%, 96.04%, and 98.98%. 

The mean is (96.04 + 96.79 + 96.04 + 98.98) / 4 = 97.07%.
